title: All India Bar Exam-XXI Results To Be Declared Today, 65.92% Candidates Qualify
description: The results of All India Bar Examination-XXI (AIBE-XXI) will be declared on Saturday (July 18), a press note by the Bar Council of India states wherein 65.92% of the candidates have qualified the bar exam.� The press release states: "The Bar Council of India is going to declare the result of AIBE-XXI today.
